name: UI UX Pro Max
summary: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms, including a design-system generator, a searchable style taxonomy, and per-stack component catalogs.

agent_entrypoints.what: One skill's instructions. Skills present at last index: banner-design, brand, design-system, design, slides, ui-styling, ui-ux-pro-max.
The searchable style taxonomy as CSV. Useful for mapping a loose aesthetic brief onto named styles.
Per-stack component and library catalog, e.g. stacks/nextjs.csv, stacks/shadcn.csv, stacks/flutter.csv, stacks/swiftui.csv.
Topic datasets: colors, google-fonts, icons, landing, motion, charts, products, app-interface, react-performance.
The project's own installer and design-system commands.

use_when: You need a full design system proposed from a project brief rather than assembled by hand.
The target stack is outside the React/Tailwind mainstream and you need stack-appropriate component suggestions.
You want a named, searchable style rather than an improvised aesthetic.
avoid_when: You only need one component - reaching for a whole design-system generator is overkill.
notes: The repository is the free tier of a project that also sells a premium version. Everything indexed here is from the MIT-licensed open repository.
